payload.text: ST0081 WP-03, after the VM run, on vc's yes of 2026-10-12 to interface (1), which vc relayed to devbin-vc. The install step's ONE home is a bare `## Linux` section in docs/install.md, so the anchor stays #linux; the WSL specifics go in a new top-level docs/windows-wsl.md, which links to install.md#linux and never restates it. vc's three asks: (a) link docs/windows-wsl.md from docs/index.md; (b) every command on both pages comes from the VM's run of the package; (c) install.md's "Verifying an install" and "What the install has to contain" read true for the Linux package, by a line or by a pointer. The WSL page names jq and shellcheck beside Intent, because interface (2) is intent, shellcheck, git and jq.
